reason: A Windows desktop shell for launching and embedding an installed DeepSeek Harness, with theme synchronization, tray behavior, and local process lifecycle management.

summaries.zh: 为已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面外壳，支持嵌入式界面、主题同步、系统托盘行为和本地进程管理。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop shell for an installed DeepSeek Harness, providing an embedded interface, theme synchronization, tray behavior, and local process management.

capabilities: Launches an installed DeepSeek Harness CLI process
Reuses an existing local Harness server when available
Embeds the Harness web interface in a WebView2 desktop shell
Injects theme and close-behavior scripts into the embedded web interface
Provides tray and close behavior controls
Terminates spawned server process trees on exit
Writes its own local configuration and logs
